quest.title: Reunion With the Dragon
quest.description: Dvalin's tears restored the Holy Lyre back to its full power. Now, you are finally ready to purify Stormterror.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x325, Primogem x20, Mora x8050, Memory of Roving Gales x1, Character EXP x4200, Fine Enhancement Ore x9

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Everyone is finally here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a view...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Lovely for a fated reunion, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well, we must be prepared for a fight.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Regardless of the outcome, things finally seem to be taking a turn for the better.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Mondstadt has really been going through so much recently...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Huh! In the end, the solution to our problem was as simple as a traveler and a song.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I suppose the Knights of Favonius may have played a part in it too...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh, we get it, Master Diluc... Everyone, please step aside!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I, the best wandering bard of the mortal world, shall begin my performance with the Holy Lyre.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Barbat— Venti, please, be careful...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe... You've known my true identity for some time now, haven't you Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Though, I thank you for continuing to use the name Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: How's the Holy Lyre?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Can it still be played? Or does it need to be repaired?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I think it's beyond repair...

choices.text: We can't let this Abyss Mage get away!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: You're right. If we don't fight the evil at its source, then we can't save Dvalin at all.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: In which case I shall call upon Outrider Amber to track it down...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: No need.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Why is that?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I eradicated one not long ago, in one of the Four Winds' temples.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? When...?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If you want to track those monsters down, then I'll seek answers from my contacts. I've got other means for getting the job done.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Diluc...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though he dislikes the Knights of Favonius, he protects Mondstadt in his own way.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ooh? Why does our little Paimon sound so doting all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hmph.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Wait for my word.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I'll be sure to let the Abyss Order know that their blatant disregard for Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: ...will not go unpunished.

choices.text: Dvalin is in a lot of danger...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: No, we should make that Abyss Mage pay first!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If we don't fight the evil at its source, then we can't save Dvalin at all.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Huh? What's this...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: After the Abyss Mage was defeated, a certain energy dispersed from its body...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: This energy was meant to isolate me from Dvalin.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you know of <color=#00E1FFFF>Stormterror's Lair</color>?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But Jean and Master Diluc are no doubt aware of it.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Agreed.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Now Dvalin has turned the ruins into his lair.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Similar to the storms that enveloped Mondstadt, the entrance to his lair is also protected by nigh-invincible barriers.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But now, as the energy dispersed from the Abyss Mage, I was able to read the rhythmic flow of how the barrier's magic was woven.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I must admit, it sounds even more horrendous than a chorus of hilichurls, but...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...It should be enough to let us break through the storm barrier and reach <color=#00E1FFFF>Stormterror's Lair</color>.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Which means we're going to confront Dvalin?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I'm fine with that... Jean is the one who wishes to avoid any direct confrontation.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: No. When there are no other options left, it is my responsibility to alter our course of action.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: If slaying him is our only choice, I will gladly become the knight that leads the charge.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Fortunately, we have yet to need to go that far.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: By that, you mean...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I mean that the Holy Lyre is not our trump card.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Our real trump card? {NICKNAME} of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Is it because I purified the Teardrop Crystal?
Is it because I can fight?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Well... You definitely are a force to be reckoned with.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But you have a much more precious forte.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I understood it all when I touched the magical energy that dispersed from the Abyss Mage.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The impurities in the tears and the curse that bind Dvalin belong to the same maleficent power.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The ancient Anemo power that coursed through his body has run dry after his attack on Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #The tides have turned since {NICKNAME} first saw him.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Dvalin can only remain active by fueling himself with his own curse.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Which means...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! You Tone-Deaf Bard, don't you see how crazy this is?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You've seen what Dvalin is like when he's ticked off! {NICKNAME} will be swallowed whole before {M#he}{F#she} even gets to lift a finger!

choices.text: A friendly reminder that I'm a competent warrior.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: ...Hey.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Nice plan. Worth a shot.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I am with you, Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems it's gonna be one heck of a battle...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ho~! So we just need to fight monsters from the abyss... and a dragon! No pressure or anything.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Humans aren't without their strengths. Let's go.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: And so...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The epic actions of brave heroes finally leads to this eleventh hour.

choices.text: This battle... it's going to take everything everyone's got.
I think I've heard people talking about it in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I believe the people of Mondstadt have all heard of it.

choices.text: When we tried to enter, we were...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: When we tried to enter, we were blocked off by the storm barrier.
